start-at-the-outcome.title: Start at the outcome
start-at-the-outcome.script: Here are three tips for a lean workflow, and the first is to start from the goal and its measurable outcome, not from today's roles. The roles tell you who is available, and the outcome tells you what is needed.

contract-on-every-milestone.title: Contract on every milestone
contract-on-every-milestone.script: The second is to put a contract on every milestone and leave the inside of each step free. You decide what must arrive and how it is checked, and the person or the agent works out the rest inside the step.

cut-seams.title: Cut seams
cut-seams.script: The third is to cut seams. Every seam is a place where a gap can hide, so merge the steps that produce nothing anyone can review.

not-more-meetings.title: Not more meetings
not-more-meetings.script: Remember the question from the first Slide? One answer was to get them talking, to hold more meetings. You did not need more meetings, you needed contracts.
